These terms govern your use of the Turne waitlist website operated by [LEGAL ENTITY NAME] ("Turne", "we", "us"). By joining the waitlist you accept these terms. Please also read our Privacy policy.

Part A: Waitlist terms

A1. What the waitlist is

Turne is a digital event and brand engagement platform in pre-launch. The waitlist is a way to register your interest and secure early access. Joining the waitlist does not create an account on the Turne platform and does not oblige you to use Turne when it launches.

A2. Eligibility

You must be at least [13] years old and hold a valid WhatsApp number to join. Some experiences and giveaways carry their own minimum age, which will be stated at the time.

A3. Verification and one entry per number

Your registration is complete only once your mobile number is verified by the one-time password we send you by SMS. Each mobile number may hold one waitlist entry. Attempting to register the same number more than once will return your existing entry rather than creating a new one.

A4. Waitlist position

Positions are assigned in the order that registrations are verified, continuing from our existing member count. Your position is final once assigned and cannot be transferred, sold or exchanged.

A5. Conduct

You agree not to submit false information, register numbers you do not control, use automated tools or scripts to register, or otherwise attempt to manipulate waitlist positions or Premium allocation. We may remove any entry that breaches this clause, without notice.

A6. Launch timing

The countdown on our website shows our planned launch timeline. Launch dates for pre-launch products move. We may change the launch date, and doing so does not entitle you to any compensation.

Part B: Premium membership terms

B1. The first-10,000 offer

The first 10,000 verified waitlist members qualify for Turne Lifetime Premium membership at no cost. Qualification is determined by verified registration order and is allocated automatically by our systems. Once 10,000 spots are allocated, the offer closes.

B2. What "Lifetime" means

"Lifetime" means for as long as Turne operates the Premium membership tier and your membership remains in good standing. It does not mean any specific number of years, and it does not survive the discontinuation of the Turne service.

B3. Premium benefits may evolve

Premium benefits are not finalised. We describe the current intended benefits on our website, and they may change, expand or be replaced as Turne develops. We will not reduce the core Premium entitlement without telling members.

Currently intended benefits include: access to the Premium allocation of selected giveaway opportunities, early access to selected experiences, and priority on new opportunities as they are introduced. Nothing in this list is a guarantee of a specific feature at a specific time.

B4. Not transferable

Premium membership is personal to you and tied to your verified WhatsApp number. It cannot be sold, gifted or transferred.

B5. Withdrawal for abuse

We may suspend or withdraw Premium membership where we reasonably believe it was obtained through fraud, automation, duplicate registration or other abuse of these terms.

Part C: Giveaway terms

C1. Giveaways are a participation mechanic, not gambling

Turne giveaways are free to enter for eligible members. There is no purchase requirement, no stake, no wager and no consideration of any kind required to enter. Turne is not a gambling, betting or gaming-for-money platform.

C2. The 50/50 allocation

For eligible giveaways, giveaway opportunities are allocated as follows: 50% to the normal-member share and 50% to the Premium-member share. Winners are drawn within each share.

Premium does not guarantee that you will win anything. It provides access to the Premium share of selected giveaway opportunities. Your chance of winning depends on how many people enter that share.

Not every giveaway will use this split. Where a giveaway has different allocation rules, those rules will be stated on the giveaway itself and will take precedence over this clause.

C3. Per-giveaway rules

Each giveaway may set its own entry window, eligibility criteria (including minimum age, city or verification requirements), entry method, number of prizes and draw date. These specific rules are published with the giveaway and form part of these terms for that giveaway.

C4. Prizes

Prizes may include physical products, event tickets, discount coupons, digital products, memberships, experiences and other brand rewards. Prizes are as described at the time of the giveaway, are not exchangeable for cash unless expressly stated, and may be substituted for a prize of equal or greater value where the original becomes unavailable.

C5. Winner selection and notification

Unless a giveaway states otherwise, winners are selected at random from valid entries within the applicable share. We will notify winners on the WhatsApp number associated with their account. If a winner does not respond within [7] days, or cannot accept the prize, we may redraw.

C6. Disqualification

We may disqualify entries that use multiple accounts, false details, automation, or any method designed to gain an unfair advantage.

C7. Brands shown on our website

Any brand names, logos or campaigns shown in our website mockups and previews are illustrative examples only. They do not indicate a partnership, sponsorship or endorsement unless we have expressly announced one.

C8. Taxes

Winners are responsible for any taxes arising from a prize, except where we are required by law to deduct tax at source, in which case we will do so and inform the winner.
